articles.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
articles.snippet: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

articles.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
articles.snippet: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

articles.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
articles.snippet: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

articles.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
articles.snippet: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.

articles.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
articles.snippet: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.
